embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:c11778f.title: Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:c11778f.description: About Flick Flick is defining the future interface for AI-native filmmaking. Think Figma and Cursor, but for creating AI films. Founded by Ray Wang (engineer who built Instagram Stories) and Zoey Zhang (award-winning filmmaker). Well-funded by top VCs including Y Combinator, Google Ventures, True Ventures, and Lightspeed. The Role Founding front-end engineer. Lead the development of the core experience of Flick — the canvas, timeline, and creative tooling. Work directly with founders and shape the future interface for AI visual storytelling. Responsibilities • Lead the architecture and development of editor UI from the ground up (canvas, timeline, node graph, playback) • Rapidly prototype and iterate on new creative workflows to validate ideas and user experience • Establish best practices for code quality, performance, testing, and maintainability • Collaborate closely with design, product, and AI backend teams to shape end-to-end user experience • Drive key technical and product decisions as part of the founding engineering team Required Qualifications • 3+ years of experience • Experience owning and leading technical initiatives on high-performance web applications • Strong expertise with modern front-end tooling (React, TypeScript, build systems, CI/CD) • Deep experience optimizing complex UX interactions, especially in editors, canvases, visual builders, or multimedia tools • Ability to design scalable UI architectures and manage large, dynamic client-side state • Passion for creating fast, intuitive, and beautiful creative interfaces • Startup mindset: thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership, solve ambiguous problems at scale Nice-to-Have Qualifications • Experience with video editors, creative canvas, animation/keyframe systems, design tools, node-graph editors, or similar • Love films and art • Open-source contributions and personal coding projects outside regular work Compensation • $100,000 – $200,000 / year + 0.10% – 1.00% equity • Visa sponsorship available

todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:1bef70.title: Senior Product Manager II (TodayTix)
todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:1bef70.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to join the TodayTix product team and raise the bar for how we build. TodayTix is TTG's flagship consumer product, it is the mobile app and web experience connecting millions of people with live events they love. Your work will directly shape how customers discover, purchase, and return to TodayTix, and will move the metrics that matter most to the business. This is an outcome ownership role, not a project execution role. The team is in an acceleration phase sharpening prioritization, deepening analytical rigor, and shifting from shipping projects to owning results. You'll be central to that shift: someone who can pick up any problem space, build conviction quickly from ambiguity, and own it end-to-end, while modeling the product craft that lifts the whole team. If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, reach instinctively for AI to think and prototype, and are passionate about turning open-ended problems into measurable bets, we'd love to hear from you. Please note: This is a full-time position. Qualified candidates must be based in the greater New York City area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.
responsibilities: Take full end-to-end accountability for specific TodayTix consumer product areas and their respective KPIs
Use AI tools to create prototypes, synthesize research, and communicate product ideas clearly and efficiently.
Collaborate closely with engineering, design and partner teams to deliver consumer features that solve real customer problems.
Lead by example to champion high-quality product standards and analytical rigor, utilizing your own work and constructive feedback to elevate the collective thinking of the team.
Manage complex cross-functional initiatives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.
Operate across the product lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and validating concepts to delivering and iterating on solutions.

turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:4dd4830b-51.title: Senior Executive Assistant - Investment
turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:4dd4830b-51.description: ABOUT TURN/RIVER Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that applies a proprietary growth engineering strategy to investing, partnering with software businesses to accelerate growth and build enduring value. The firm’s team of equal parts investors and operators provides hands-on operational support and the flexible capital to systematically scale marketing, sales and customer success at its portfolio companies. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Senior Executive Assistant to join our high-performing, fast-paced team. This role is ideal for an experienced administrative professional (9+ years) who thrives in complex environments and brings a polished, confident presence while supporting seasoned operators and investors. You will serve as a trusted partner to a Senior Partner, helping manage demanding schedules, high-stakes meetings, global travel, and constantly shifting priorities with exceptional organization, judgment, and discretion. The right person is proactive, detail-oriented, and calm under pressure — someone who stays several steps ahead, communicates thoughtfully, and creates clarity and efficiency for the executive. This role requires strong follow-through, adaptability, professionalism, and a genuine service mindset, along with the ability to operate independently while handling highly sensitive information with care and integrity. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Provide proactive, high-level administrative support to a Senior Partner, ensuring smooth daily operations and alignment with evolving priorities - Take full ownership of a demanding and complex calendar, scheduling internal and external meetings across time zones while continuously adjusting to new priorities and time-sensitive changes. - Coordinate all aspects of frequent domestic and international travel, including multi-leg itineraries, visa requirements, and unexpected adjustments, often on tight timelines. - Closely monitor the executive’s schedule, flagging conflicts, sharing relevant context, and ensuring they’re fully prepared for every meeting and commitment. - Prepare and submit accurate, timely expense reports; maintain organized records and manage reconciliation with strong attention to detail. - Monitor and communicate relevant meeting or schedule context (cancellations, shifts, or prep needs) with a clear, thoughtful, and timely approach - Draft and manage correspondence, reports, and meeting materials with clarity, warmth, and professionalism, often working independently with minimal oversight. - Handle highly sensitive information with discretion, sound judgment, and the highest level of integrity. - Serve as a trusted partner, anticipating needs, staying several steps ahead, and taking initiative to resolve issues before they escalate. - Step in to support fellow Executive Assistants when needed, contributing to a highly collaborative and dependable administrative team. QUALIFICATIONS - 9+ years of experience providing high-level support to senior executives in demanding, fast-paced environments. - Proven ability to manage complex and constantly shifting calendars, including seamless coordination of international meetings and travel. - Recognized for attention to detail and strong follow-through, with a track record of managing multiple priorities without letting anything fall through the cracks. - Highly responsive and adaptable, able to stay composed and effective in fast-changing situations. - Demonstrates strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills; anticipates needs, communicates proactively, and removes obstacles with minimal oversight. - Exceptional communication skills, representing executives and the organization with professionalism, clarity, and a warm, confident presence. - Exercises excellent judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information. - Proact
